args:
{"commands":["set -eu
for d in /opt/cwm-bench/results/raw/typical-later-day-20261006/typical-later-day-*; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  printf "RECOVERY_DIR=%s\n" "$d"
  cat "$d/identity.json"
  for f in started_at completed_at exit.code pid; do
    if [ -f "$d/$f" ]; then printf "\nRECOVERY_%s=%s\n" "$f" "$(cat "$d/$f")"; fi
  done
  if [ -f "$d/pid" ]; then p="$(cat "$d/pid")"; if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "RECOVERY_PROCESS=alive"; else echo "RECOVERY_PROCESS=not-running"; fi; fi
done"]}
